company.name: Novelcare
company.shortDescription: Novelcare provides software that connects community medical practices and trial sites by matching patient records to local clinical studies.
company.description: Novelcare develops health technology and enterprise software that focuses on clinical trial patient recruitment. The company integrates with electronic medical and health record systems using Bulk FHIR and vendor-supported APIs to analyze structured and unstructured clinical data. Its platform automatically matches patient profiles with nearby, medically relevant clinical trial criteria and generates match reports for physicians. Novelcare offers a Study Access Program and matching platform that fits into existing outpatient practice workflows with minimal disruption. It also provides a HIPAA-compliant inbox and referral portal that supports eligibility reviews, patient notifications, and introductions to trial sites. By connecting community-based practices, patients, and research sponsors, Novelcare helps clinicians present clinical research as a care option and helps trial sites identify potential participants.
